key_points: KeyBanc and Citi downgrade Comcast to sell and cut price targets to $27.5
Analysts cite subscriber losses, slower theme park growth and uncertainty around NBCUniversal spinoff
Multiple analyst cuts signal short‑term pressure on the stock
Free cash flow remains strong but share price already down ~43% from two‑year high
No new earnings or guidance surprise; impact likely limited to near‑term sentiment
